info.description: The task inbox and lifecycle contract of the hmntsk engine. Identical across every supported web framework binding. Authentication, authorisation of the caller's identity, rate limiting, CORS and TLS belong to the host; the engine takes the acting actor as an input the host establishes.
info.title: hmntsk human task API

get.summary: Read a task type's input and output schemas.

parameters.description: Tasks reserved for this actor; `me` names the acting user.
parameters.name: assignee

parameters.description: Tasks this actor may act on, with group membership resolved now; `me` names the acting user.
parameters.name: candidate

parameters.description: Tasks whose candidate pool names this group, as configured: no membership is resolved.
parameters.name: group

parameters.description: Restrict to these lifecycle states.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Restrict to these task types.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Correlation: the kind of thing that owns the task.
parameters.name: ownerType

parameters.description: Correlation: the owning unit of work.
parameters.name: ownerRef

parameters.description: Correlation: the step the task stands for.
parameters.name: activityKey

parameters.description: Tasks due strictly before this instant.
parameters.name: dueBefore

parameters.description: Page size.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Continue a previous page. It is bound to the ordering and direction that produced it.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The ordering: creation by default; urgency is priority, then due date, then creation.
parameters.name: orderBy

parameters.description: The direction of the ordering, asc by default. Tasks without a deadline sort last either way.
parameters.name: direction

400.description: The request or its payload failed validation, or named a task type that is not registered.

403.description: The acting actor is not eligible for the task or is not its assignee, or the query authorization policy refused the query. By default an actor may query only their own inbox.

500.description: The request could not be completed. A failure to resolve group membership lands here rather than on 403: the engine could not decide, which is not the same as deciding against the caller.
